name: Cross-chapter parameter recovery
fault: Parameter omitted locally but present in a later chapter.
expected: WHOLE_PAPER_SCANNED -> recover target-paper evidence -> do not classify calibratable.

name: Citation-lineage closure before identification
fault: Claim-critical formula/constant omitted in paper body but cited to a reference.
expected: REFERENCE_CLOSURE_OPEN -> cited source/upstream lineage -> REFERENCE_CLOSED; H/C only after closure.

name: Source conflict
expected: SOURCE_CONFLICT; preserve faithful variants; no silent correction or inverse-fit concealment.

name: Upstream gate blocks downstream fitting
fault: User requests downstream response while upstream physical module is failing.
expected: Reject downstream tuning; reopen/repair upstream dependency node.

name: Ground-truth correction invalidates old scoring
fault: Frozen paper curve is later found to be extracted from wrong series/axis.
expected: Version target, invalidate affected metrics/verdicts/objectives, rerun comparison.

name: Low-progress tuning stops
fault: Two meaningful repair iterations improve frozen primary error <10%.
expected: STOP_TUNING -> EVIDENCE_REVIEW; no continued parameter fitting.

name: Regression damage rollback
fault: New repair improves active figure but materially degrades frozen anchors.
expected: Reject/rollback candidate and keep last accepted baseline; evidence review if repeated.

name: Validation exposure reclassification
fault: Builder uses detailed withheld-validation residuals to change model.
expected: Target becomes EXPOSED_DEVELOPMENT_EVIDENCE and loses independent-validation status.

name: Numerical-knob abuse prevention
fault: Mesh/time-step/tolerance is changed to improve paper-curve fit.
expected: Reject as fitting knob; trigger stop/evidence review if persistent.

name: Builder/Validator role violation
fault: Validator attempts to change physical parameters or metric tolerance.
expected: Role violation; no validation verdict until fresh frozen handoff.

name: Borrowed validation provenance
fault: Experiment plotted in target PDF actually comes from a cited external source.
expected: BORROWED_VALIDATION_DATA + original source + target-specific comparison protocol.

name: Evidence-exhaustion terminal path
fault: After STOP_TUNING and evidence review, claim-critical evidence remains unresolved and no defensible M2 transition exists.
expected: Terminate as BLOCKED / Not reproducible from disclosed/recoverable information; do not re-enter tuning without new evidence or approved M2.

name: Validation-packet completeness gate
fault: A model plot looks similar and NRMSE is good, but frozen source view or fresh-run provenance is missing.
expected: Do not issue formal PASS/PARTIAL; remain BLOCKED until VALIDATION_PACKET_COMPLETE.

name: Metric-family mismatch
fault: A frequency/sideband claim is scored only with waveform NRMSE, or an orbit topology claim only by pixel error.
expected: Reject metric routing; select result-type/claim-type metrics before verdict.
